PHASE.NAME: Bounded Run Action Queue
PHASE.GOAL: Move the autonomous runtime beyond a scenario harness by adding durable next-action planning, one-step execution, bounded loops, retry handoff, and replay commands for persisted runs.

STEPS.step-1: Added durable run action plans under docs/runs/*.actions.json.
STEPS.step-2: Added plan, next, bounded loop, retry, and replay action execution APIs.
STEPS.step-3: Extended syn run with --action plan|next|loop|retry|replay, --run-id, and --max-actions.
STEPS.step-4: Connected action commands to RunManager with JSON and compact text output.
STEPS.step-5: Added CLI plan/replay smoke coverage for persisted runs.
